risk.summary: Crisis-level VIX (367.36) combined with earnings binary event in 7 days creates extreme near-term risk; normal yield curve provides limited offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200, SMA 50/200, Supertrend) is bullish with oversold RSI 9 and stochastic cross offering potential bounce into extreme fear (VIX 367), creating a contrarian opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary event in 7 days combined with crisis-level VIX, negative momentum (MACD, OBV, CMF), price below all key moving averages, and zero fundamental/insider conviction make this a high-risk, low-probability swing entry with unfavorable macro backdrop.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term structure remains bullish with EMA/SMA alignment and oversold conditions present contrarian opportunity in extreme fear environment.
